keyboard.action: Into the group: focus the checked radio, or the first radio when none is checked. From the group: leave it.
As Tab, backward; the entry target is the same (some browsers put a native unchecked group on its last radio).
Check the focused radio if it is not checked.
Move focus to the next radio and check it, unchecking the previous one; wrap from last to first.
Move focus to the next radio and check it, unchecking the previous one; wrap from last to first.
Move focus to the previous radio and check it, unchecking the previous one; wrap from first to last.
Move focus to the previous radio and check it, unchecking the previous one; wrap from first to last.
Check the focused radio if it is not checked, unchecking the other; otherwise nothing.
Check the focused radio if it is not checked, unchecking the other; otherwise nothing.
Move focus, without checking, to the next radio; from the last radio to the next toolbar element, or to the first toolbar element when the radio is also last in the toolbar.
Move focus, without checking, to the previous radio; from the first radio to the previous toolbar element, or to the last toolbar element when the radio is also first in the toolbar.
Move focus, without checking, to the next radio of the group, wrapping inside the group.
Move focus, without checking, to the previous radio of the group, wrapping inside the group.

focus.entry: The checked radio, else the first.
focus.tabStops: One (none of its own when nested in a toolbar).
focus.note: Selection follows focus in a standalone group; inside a toolbar it does not.

rtlDecisions.question: In a horizontal roving-focus composite (tabs, toolbar, menubar, radio group, toggle group), which arrow moves to the next item in RTL?
rtlDecisions.apg: Silent, apart from one aside in the tabs page that calls the last tab the right-most "in a left-to-right horizontal tab list". Keys are named physically: Right Arrow is next.

libraries.behaviour: ArrowLeft is next in RTL for tabs, toolbar and horizontal radio groups; vertical arrows never flip.
The composite root swaps the forward and backward horizontal keys when direction is rtl.
The roving focus group swaps ArrowLeft and ArrowRight before mapping a key to a focus intent when dir is rtl; toggle group, tabs, toolbar, radio group and menubar all pass dir through it.
Tabs and ToggleButtonGroup pass isRtl to the roving tabindex root.
Tabs flip the arrow offset when rtl and the tab bar is top or bottom; a horizontal menu maps Left to next when rtl.

rtlDecisions.reason: Items are laid out from inline-start, so the arrow that points at the visually following item must move to it. All five libraries agree.

data.notes: RTL: ArrowLeft goes to the next radio and ArrowRight to the previous in a horizontal layout; ArrowDown and ArrowUp never change. React Aria keeps ArrowRight as next when the group is declared vertical, even in RTL; Radix swaps the horizontal pair in RTL whenever the group listens to it (its default, with no orientation set). We mirror the horizontal pair whenever it is bound.
